description: Bright stars (G<10 Gaia DR3, plus Hipparcos-2 for stars brighter than Gaia's saturation limit).
layout: struct-of-arrays (each column is one contiguous typed-array block; read via byte_offset/byte_length below, no per-row parsing)

columns.name: mag
columns.notes: Gaia G-band mag (Gaia rows) or Hipparcos Hp mag (Hipparcos rows) -- not perfectly homogeneous, both are broadband optical

columns.name: bp_rp
columns.notes: Gaia BP-RP color index; NaN for Hipparcos-only rows (no bp_rp fetched for those)

columns.name: catalog_id
columns.notes: Gaia source_id if positive; -(HIP number) if negative

hipparcos_cut: Hpmag < 4.0, deduped against Gaia within 2.0 arcsec
